item.title: About Us
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
About SPS Medcare

SPS Medcare began in 2011 with a simple goal: make dependable medical equipment accessible and affordable for every healthcare provider and family in Delhi NCR. What started as a two-person trading desk now supplies over 2,000 products — from five-function ICU beds to consumables — to more than 500 hospitals, clinics, nursing homes, diagnostic labs and home-care patients.

Our Mission

To help healthcare facilities deliver better care by supplying certified equipment quickly, installing it correctly, and standing behind it for its whole service life.

What We Stand For

  • Certified quality — ISO 13485:2016 and CE certified equipment only.
  • Honest pricing — wholesale rates with GST invoices and transparent quotations.
  • Service after sale — free installation, staff demo, on-site warranty and AMC options.
  • Speed — same-day delivery across Delhi NCR and 2–4 day shipping pan-India.

Reach Us

Call or WhatsApp +91 99202 22362, email info@sps-medcare.com, or visit our Okhla warehouse at B-42, Okhla Industrial Area, Phase-II, New Delhi — 110020.

item.title: Apex 5-Function Electric ICU Bed
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
The Apex 5-function electric ICU bed is built for intensive care: independent electric control of backrest, knee rest, height and Trendelenburg/anti-Trendelenburg, with a one-touch CPR release that flattens the deck in seconds. Detachable ABS panels, collapsible side rails with nurse controls and a 250 kg safe load make it our most requested critical-care bed. Includes installation, demo and a 2-year on-site warranty across Delhi NCR.

Key Features

  • Fully electric backrest, knee rest, height and Trendelenburg
  • One-touch CPR quick-release function
  • Detachable ABS head and foot panels
  • Collapsible side rails with integrated nurse controls
  • 125 mm central-braking casters
  • 8-hour battery backup for power failure

Technical Specifications

  • Safe load: 250 kg
  • Functions: 5 (backrest, knee rest, height, Trendelenburg, reverse Trendelenburg)
  • Panels: Detachable ABS
  • Side rails: Collapsible, with nurse controls
  • Casters: 125 mm, central braking
  • Battery backup: 8 hours
  • Frame: Powder-coated steel
